source: asumsi: no hourly load data for Kalimantan Timur was found (docs/research). Shape of a typical PLN system day (night trough around 03.00-04.00, a flat daytime plateau, the peak at 19.00 WITA when lights and homes come on), hour 0 = 00.00-01.00 WITA. Normalised to a mean of 1 in code, so it moves the yearly average around the day and never changes the yearly kWh. For scale: the Mahakam system's 2021 peak load was 505 MW (grid-and-plants.md, bisnis.com snippet).
